title: Opinion-claims study: review and publish the real results page
description: Data collection and scoring are done: preregistration, scorer, and Laya/Kev/Jev answers for the 15-claim, 5-domain opinion-claims-antisemitism study are committed on branch feat/opinion-claims-page (cherry-picked from feat/opinion-claims + a real results page wired in, replacing the /opinion-claims/ placeholder). biased_decisions/leaderboard.py gained _opinion_claims_summary(); site/src/pages/opinion-claims/index.astro now renders each domain's sourced claims and each model's agree_pct/range per domain, including the Holocaust-denial-adjacent domain. Remaining work: review page copy, run 'make site PY=python3' + site tests on that branch, open a PR, and merge/release.
